Questions, corrections, reproducibility reports, proposals, and contributions
are welcome.

::: {.callout-note}
## Email

Contact [Bashar Elnashef](mailto:elnashefb@gmail.com) at
[`elnashefb@gmail.com`](mailto:elnashefb@gmail.com).
:::

## Corrections and reproducible problems

For a public, reproducible problem, open a
[GitHub issue](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues).
Include the affected part, equation, claim, result, or URL; what you observed;
what you expected; and the smallest supporting example or source.

If the report contains private context or you are unsure whether it should be
public, use email first. Do not send credentials, confidential employer
information, or private datasets.

## Proposals and extensions

Ideas for new checks, stronger experiments, alternative derivations, or
extensions to HOPE-R can begin by email or in an issue. For a substantial code
change, discussing the scope first helps keep the paper-literal audit separate
from proposed repairs.

## Code and documentation contributions

Pull requests are welcome for focused changes to code, tests, documentation,
or figures. Read the
[contribution guide](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/v1.0.0/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for the test commands, evidence requirements, and licensing boundaries.
